jobs.occupation: Global Procurement Specialist / Strategic Buyer (m/f/d) (Fachkaufmann/-frau - Einkauf und Logistik)
jobs.description:
About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH is
the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first
time, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab in
the heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologies
for next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared
commitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. For
our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and
committed: Global Procurement Specialist / Strategic Buyer (m/f/d) Are
you ready to secure the supply chain for Europe’s pioneer
semiconductor Greenfield project? As a Global Procurement Specialist /
Strategic Buyer, you will take ownership of the commercial end-to-end
sourcing process for critical materials supporting our brand-new
manufacturing site in Dresden. You will negotiate high-volume global
contracts, mitigate supply chain risks, and build resilient
partnerships with key international suppliers. If you thrive at the
intersection of business strategy, cross-functional collaboration, and
high-tech operations, this role offers you the ultimate platform to
make a global impact. Tasks Strategic Sourcing: Develop, negotiate,
and execute end-to-end global sourcing strategies and contracts to
ensure a highly resilient, cost-effective supply of critical
materials. Supplier Partnership Management: Build and nurture
long-term strategic relationships with a global supplier base to
secure high-quality materials and services. Commercial Negotiation:
Lead commercial negotiations, drive total cost of ownership (TCO)
optimization, and actively manage commercial risks. Performance
Monitoring : Evaluate and manage supplier performance against key
quality, delivery, cost, and risk metrics to ensure full contract
compliance. Risk & Supply Resilience: Proactively identify and resolve
supplier-related issues, including delivery disruptions and quality
deviations, using data-driven preventive actions. Cross-Functional
Alignment: Collaborate closely with engineering, fab operations,
finance, and HQ procurement teams to align sourcing activities with
production budgets and timelines. Process Excellence: Contribute to
continuous improvement initiatives to streamline procurement workflows
and scale up supply chain operations. Governance & ESG: Ensure strict
compliance with all internal policies, contractual obligations, trade
laws, and ESG standards across all purchasing activities. Profile
Required: Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher in Supply Chain
Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, IT, or a
related field. Experience: Minimum of 4 years of strategic procurement
or supply chain experience within an international industrial setting.
Negotiation Skills: Proven track record in commercial negotiations,
contract management, and strategic supplier evaluation. Languages:
Proficiency in English (C1) and German (C1) is required for seamless
collaboration with local and global stakeholders. Mindset: Strong
analytical thinking, attention to detail in contract review, and the
ability to coordinate multiple complex projects simultaneously.
International Onboarding: Willingness to complete an intensive
training of 3-6 months at TSMC Taiwan. Nice to have: Industry
Knowledge: Prior experience in the semiconductor, chemical, or
advanced materials industry. Certifications: Professional supply chain
or procurement certifications (e.g., APICS CPIM/CSCP, ISM CPSM).
Global Mindset: Experience in collaborating with Asian business
environments; Mandarin language skills are a plus. Why Join ESMC? Help
build a completely new semiconductor manufacturing site in Europe.
Work in a highly international environment with colleagues across the
world. Shape processes instead of maintaining existing structures.
Participate in global projects and cross-functional collaboration.
Additional contact details Please apply with an English resume.

jobs.occupation: Technical Product Specialist Smart Solutions m/w/d (Industriemechaniker/in)
jobs.employer_name: Construction Tools Solution Ce nter GmbH
jobs.description:
Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Using state-of-the-art technology, Epiroc develops and manufactures innovative drilling equipment and machinery for rock excavation and construction, as well as providing first-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm, Sweden. Its dedicated employees support and work closely with customers in more than 150 countries.

Do you want to make a real difference? Rock the future with a global player? Then join our team and get the ball rolling as a

Technical Product Specialist Smart Solutions (m/w/d)

Moving forward with inspiration

Key focus areas are

- Support the development, testing, and validation of innovative hydraulic attachment and smart machine solutions from concept through market launch.
- Participate in prototype assembly, field trials, product evaluations, and customer acceptance testing.
- Provide practical field feedback to Engineering, Product Management, and Service organizations to drive product improvements and customer-focused solutions.
- Assist customers and internal stakeholders in the successful adoption and deployment of smart technologies and digital solutions.
- Support root cause analysis and troubleshooting of new products and systems during field implementation.
- Execute service assignments, repairs, maintenance activities, commissioning, inspections, and troubleshooting at customer sites and in the workshop.
- Deliver technical training and operational guidance to customers and business partners.
- Provide professional technical advice regarding equipment operation, repairs, maintenance requirements, and spare parts recommendations.
- Prepare detailed and accurate service reports, machine condition assessments, and technical product reports.
- Support continuous improvement initiatives through the sharing of technical knowledge and field experience.

Strong skills

You are committed, like to take on responsibility and want to gain a deep insight into supply chain work. Ideally, you have the following skills:

- Completed technical vocational education or an equivalent qualification in mechanics, mechatronics, electrical engineering, hydraulics, or a related technical discipline.
- Strong knowledge of mechanical, hydraulic, electrical, and machine diagnostic systems.
- Experience within the mining, construction equipment, heavy machinery, or a related industry.
- Ability to diagnose technical issues and implement effective solutions in the field.
- Good understanding of common IT tools and digital service technologies.
- Experience with customer-facing technical service activities is highly desirable.
- Excellent German language skills, both written and spoken, together with basic English language skills.

More for you

Those who do a lot should also get a lot. That's why you'll benefit from an extensive range of offers that leaves almost nothing to be desired. And if you do? We are constantly working on expanding and improving our range of services - just get in touch. Here is a small excerpt of what you can expect:

Benefits in everyday working life

- Further training and development: you can still learn something with us

Career and studies

- Flexible working time models and home office options
- Gain experience in international cooperation, as you will be in regular contact with our global subsidiaries within the Epiroc Group
- Opportunity to gain professional experience parallel to your studies with the prospect of writing your thesis in an international environment

Health, sport and leisure

- Modern office equipment, free drinks
- Team events such as midsummer parties, workshops, barbecues and more

With united strength into the future

Have we inspired you? Then let's shape the future together: with innovation and commitment - and above all united. Simply apply online now via our career portal. Please let us know your earliest possible starting date.

We look forward to welcoming you to our team! We welcome applications from all people, regardless of their cultural and social background, age, religion, ideology, disability or sexual identity.

United. Inspired. Performance unites us, innovation inspires us and commitment drives us to develop further. In the 150 countries where you will find Epiroc, we encourage our employees to take responsibility for their own development and career with the support of their managers. We are committed to providing you with every opportunity to succeed in a culture of innovation, diversity and collaboration, combined with a caring atmosphere. Diversity and sustainability are key to developing fresh and innovative ideas and solutions for our customers. Epiroc is a leading manufacturer for the mining and infrastructure industry. Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com

It all starts with people. The world needs metals and minerals for the energy transition and our cities and infrastructure must be developed to serve a growing population. To succeed, we need to speed up the shift towards more sustainable mining and construction industries. We at Epiroc accelerate this transformation, together with customers and business partners in more than 150 countries, by developing and providing innovative and safe equipment, digital solutions, and aftermarket support.

All new thinkers are welcome. We are looking for those who want to develop, grow, and dare to think new. In Epiroc we attract, develop, and retain diverse talent valuing authenticity and unique perspectives, driving our spirit of innovation. We foster an inclusive culture where diversity isn't just a goal but a part of our values and way of working. This is how we do business for a sustainable future.  Learn more at www.epiroc.com (https://javascript:void(0);)

jobs.occupation: 601-2026 Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d) (Neurowissenschaftler/in)
jobs.description:
Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d) – Institute for Pharmacology and Toxicology
Ref.-Nr.  601-2026
Third-party funding

The Faculty of Medicine is an integral part of the Otto-von-Guericke-University Magdeburg and cooperates with the Magdeburg University Hospital A.ö.R. in research, teaching and patient care.

Your Responsibilities:

We are seeking two highly motivated Postdoctoral Research Fellows to join our team investigating the molecular and cellular organization of the nervous system using cutting-edge spatial transcriptomics approaches. The successful candidates will work at the interface of neuroscience, genomics, and computational biology to map gene expression patterns across brain tissue with spatial resolution, contributing to our understanding of neural circuit organization, development, and disease.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a collaborative, well-resourced research environment with access to state-of-the-art spatial profiling platforms (e.g., MERFISH, 10x Visium), advanced microscopy, and high-performance computing infrastructure.

Two positions are available with complementary focus:

- Position 1 — Experimental/Wet-lab focus: Designing and executing spatial transcriptomics experiments on neural tissue, including tissue preparation, probe design, imaging, and data generation
- Position 2 — Computational/Analytical focus: Developing and applying computational pipelines for spatial transcriptomic data analysis, including cell-type mapping, spatial statistics, and integration with single-cell/single-nucleus datasets

(Candidates with strong interest and skills spanning both areas are also encouraged to apply and may be considered for either position.)

Key Responsibilities:

- Design, plan, and conduct spatial transcriptomics experiments on neural tissue samples
- Analyze and interpret complex spatial and single-cell genomic datasets
- Collaborate with neuroscientists, computational biologists, and clinicians within and outside the group
- Present findings at lab meetings, seminars, and international conferences
- Prepare manuscripts for peer-reviewed publication
- Contribute to grant writing and mentoring of graduate/undergraduate students
- Maintain rigorous documentation and adhere to good research and data management practices

Your Profile:

Essential Qualifications:

- A PhD (completed or close to completion) in Neuroscience, Molecular/Cell Biology, Genomics, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, or a related field
- Demonstrated research productivity (peer-reviewed publications and/or preprints)
- Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

For the experimental-focus position, in addition:

- Hands-on experience with molecular biology techniques (e.g., histology, immunohistochemistry, in situ hybridization, RNA-seq library prep)
- Experience with spatial transcriptomics platforms (e.g., Visium, MERFISH, Xenium, seqFISH) is highly desirable
- Experience with rodent or human brain tissue handling is a plus

For the computational-focus position, in addition:

- Strong programming skills (Python and/or R)
- Experience analyzing single-cell/single-nucleus RNA-seq or spatial transcriptomics data
- Familiarity with relevant packages/tools (e.g., Scanpy, Seurat, Squidpy, STUtility) and statistical/machine learning methods
- Experience with high-performance/cluster computing is a plus

We offer:

- Access to cutting-edge spatial transcriptomics and imaging technology
- A collaborative, interdisciplinary, and supportive research environment
- Funding and support to attend international conferences
- Opportunities for career development, mentoring, and grant-writing training
- Work and family in harmony: Through Klinikzwerge (https://kita.med.ovgu.de/) , childcare may be available, subject to availability
- Help protect the environment and enjoy discounted public transportation through a job ticket
- In addition, we offer a diverse range of sports and relaxation activities as part of our workplace health promotion program
- Onboarding: At the start of your employment, you will participate in our orientation program, where you will receive important information and training sessions

Terms and Conditions:

- **Salary: **The salary group E 13 according to “Tarifvertrag für den öffentlichen Dienst der Länder” awaits you

jobs.occupation: Research Associate / PhD Candidate in Cellular and Circuit Neuroscience (m/f/x) (Neurowissenschaftler/in)
jobs.description:
In order to fill a fixed-term position in part-time (25,8895 hrs/wk = 65%) starting in March 2027, we are looking for 1

Research Associate / PhD Candidate in Cellular and Circuit Neuroscience (m/f/x)

The newly established research group of Prof. Dr. Timothy Zolnik at the Faculty of Biology and Biotechnology, Ruhr University Bochum, investigates how deep cortical neurons influence cortical and thalamic circuits. Our work combines cellular electrophysiology with optogenetics, pharmacology and circuit approaches to study mechanisms relevant to attention and arousal.

The PhD candidate will investigate cellular and synaptic mechanisms in defined cortical circuits, with a focus on layer 6b and its interactions with other cortical and thalamic neurons. The project centers on whole-cell recordings in acute mouse brain slices, combined with optogenetic circuit mapping and quantitative analysis.

Scope: part-time
Duration: fixed-term, 3 years
Start: starting in March 2027
Apply by:  2026-10-26

Your tasks:

• Design and perform whole-cell patch-clamp experiments in acute mouse brain slices.

• Measure intrinsic neuronal properties and synaptic responses in identified cell types.

• Combine electrophysiology with optogenetic circuit mapping and pharmacological manipulations.

• Perform or assist with stereotaxic viral injections and prepare tissue for recordings and histology.

• Analyze, visualize and interpret electrophysiological data using quantitative methods.

• Document experiments and present results in lab meetings and at scientific conferences.

• Contribute to scientific manuscripts and the collaborative development of the research group.

Your profile:

• A completed Master’s degree (or equivalent) in neuroscience, biology, physiology, biomedical sciences or a related field (required).

• Hands-on experience with whole-cell patch-clamp recordings in acute ex vivo brain slices (required).

• Experience analyzing and interpreting electrophysiological data (required).

• A strong interest in cellular, synaptic and circuit neuroscience, with careful experimental practice (required).

• Very good written and spoken English and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively (required).

• Experience with stereotaxic viral injections and/or optogenetics (desirable).

• Experience with neuropharmacology, histology, microscopy and/or programming for data analysis (advantageous).

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

As Manager (f/m/d) 9HL PDT, you will lead a global team of highly skilled turbine frame professionals responsible for the SGT-9000HL frame turbine module. You will provide technical and people leadership across product development, design, validation, fleet improvement, and lifecycle support while ensuring effective interfaces with manufacturing, service, procurement, fleet management, product management, and project organizations. You will translate complex technical and business priorities into clear direction, accountable work packages, and timely decisions that strengthen product reliability, performance, cost competitiveness, and customer value.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Lead, coach, and develop a global team of engineering professionals, ensuring strong performance, capability growth, and successful execution of turbine development activities.
* Define and drive the technical strategy, priorities, and execution roadmap for SGT-9000HL turbine-module development, upgrades, fleet improvements, and issue-resolution initiatives.
* Lead complex turbine frame design reviews and technical decision-making across the full product lifecycle, from concept development through manufacturing, testing, verification, validation, and product release.
* Direct technical programs, root cause analyses (RCA), and design down-selection activities, ensuring delivery within quality, schedule, and budget targets.
* Own resource planning, budget allocation, and manpower management, while establishing robust engineering processes and clear work packages to achieve business objectives.
* Foster cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Manufacturing, Service, Procurement, and Project organizations to support fleet performance, market introduction, customer communication, and long-term technology roadmap execution.

What You Bring

* Master’s degree or PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a comparable engineering discipline
* Extensive experience in gas turbine product design and development, including turbine frames, hot gas path components, and mechanical integrity
* Advanced expertise in gas turbine engineering, heat transfer, turbine module development, and relevant engineering tools such as Siemens NX, Teamcenter, and SAP
* Proven leadership and development of diverse, global engineering teams, including coaching, resource planning, and performance management
* Strong project management and strategic planning capabilities, including experience with Agile or KANBAN methodologies
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, including business-fluent English and German and coordination across Manufacturing, Service, and Procurement

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.description:

Senior Principal Peptide Scientist - External API Development (all genders)

As a Senior Principal Peptide Scientist External API Development (m/f/d), you shape the chemical foundation of our peptide pipeline by defining and delivering phase-appropriate drug substance strategies, synthetic routes, manufacturing processes, and supply solutions through an external CDMO network. In this role, you represent Drug Substance Chemistry within the global CMC Technical Development team and are accountable for the drug substance contribution to the overall CMC package. Apply if you want to combine scientific leadership with strategic decision-making and pragmatic execution across development and manufacturing.

YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

- You lead the design, evaluation, and optimization of synthetic routes and manufacturing processes for peptide APIs, balancing speed, quality, safety, cost, sustainability, scalability, and process understanding
- You define phase-appropriate drug substance strategies and select suitable peptide synthesis, purification, isolation, and manufacturing approaches
- You Provide scientific expertise on protecting-group strategies, coupling and deprotection, aggregation, epimerization, oxidation, impurity formation, purification, isolation, and stability

- Lead process transfers across external partners and into internal development or manufacturing organizations, ensuring knowledge continuity, documentation, troubleshooting, and compliance falls under your responsibility

WHO YOU ARE

- You bring strong expertise in peptide drug substance development and manufacturing, including solid-phase, liquid-phase, hybrid, fragment-based, and emerging synthesis technologies
